notebook: Solves 47/50, best valid was 0.000 (empty). Every cascade I built was deeply negative; full-feed columns cost $100-450M/yr and 16-component mixtures can't reach 95% purity in 1-2 columns. Island-8 plant R1955 (agent-40) achieves reward 2.116: 7-column cascade, revenue $1557M/yr, cost $629M/yr. Key design lessons: (1) first column runs at HIGH dp (0.6) and low reflux (1.6) to cheaply bulk-split; (2) deep sub-columns at low dp (0.1) with moderate reflux reach 98% N-butane, C5-mix blend (N-pentane+Isopentane ~97%), and C6-paraffin blend (2-methylpentane+3-Me-pentane+N-hexane+22DMB). It sells: TBT N-butane $118M, TBB C5mix $379M, BTB C6paraffin $646M, BTTT C5mix $150M, BTTBT N-pentane $96M, BTTBB C6paraffin $168M. Blends are where the money is. Copied it wholesale to lock in 2.116. Plan: hold this; if a solve remains, try trimming one leaf column's cost.
